Рам Та защищает совместимый модуль Страж: Ram Tah can protect compatible Guardian modules from degradation in an Anti-Guardian field. Apply this upgrade to Guardian weapons before fighting in such a zone.
У термического оружия наёмников 15,5% ур: Converts 15.5% of thermal mercenary weapon damage to absolute damage. At G5, total damage falls by 11% and power draw rises by 40%.
На G5 топливозаборник принимает на 50% б: At G5, the fuel scoop takes in 50% more fuel per second and draws 15% more power. You can collect more fuel in a single pass by a star.
На G5 целостность силовой установки раст: At G5, power plant integrity rises by 120% and output by 12%. The heat efficiency coefficient drops by 12% and mass rises by 20%.
На G5 SYS, ENG и WEP пополняются на 45%: At G5, SYS, ENG and WEP recharge 45% faster and each capacitor holds 5% less. Suitable for repeated boosts and sustained fire.
На G5 тепловая нагрузка двигателей снижа: At G5, thruster heat load falls by 60% and the optimal performance multiplier rises by 28%. Thrusters draw 16% more power even though thrust generates less heat.
На G5 оптимальный множитель тяги растёт: At G5, the optimal thruster multiplier rises by 40%. Thermal load rises by 60% and optimal mass falls by 12.5%, so check performance at full load.
На G5 радиус покрытия зонда подробного с: At G5, the Detailed Surface Scanner probe radius increases by 50%. You can map a large body with fewer probes and reach the efficiency bonus more easily.
На G5 время запуска FSD после включения: At G5, FSD boot time falls by 80% and optimal mass rises by 15%. Useful when deploying hardpoints shuts the FSD down under your power priorities. Jump charge time is unchanged.
На G5 ёмкость каждого конденсатора увели: At G5, each capacitor holds 42% more energy and recharges 18% more slowly. A full WEP capacitor can sustain the first burst longer and takes longer to refill.
На G5 оптимальная масса FSD растёт на 55: At G5, FSD optimal mass rises by 55%. Compare loaded jump range with Mass Manager and Deep Charge before a long trip.
У оружия G5 удваивает предельную дальнос: At G5, weapons reach twice as far and damage falloff begins at the new maximum range. Scanners and FSD interdictors gain acquisition range at the cost of a narrower angle.
На G5 коэффициент нагрева силовой устано: At G5, the power plant heat efficiency coefficient drops by 65%, output drops by 15%, and mass rises by 20%. Useful for a cool build if the remaining output covers your equipment.
У силовой установки G5 выработка растёт: At G5, power plant output rises by 40% at the cost of heat and integrity. Weapon damage per shot rises by 70% at the cost of WEP energy and heat. Multi-cannons also lose magazine capacity.
На G4 время подготовки банки щита сокращ: At G4, shield cell spin-up time falls by 40%. A charge lasts for less time and restores 20% more shield. The shorter spin-up gives opponents less time to land Feedback Cascade.
На G5 интервал между очередями сокращает: At G5, burst intervals fall by 44% and reload time by 65%. Damage per shot drops and jitter increases by 0.5°, which is especially noticeable at range.
На G5 большинство вспомогательных устрой: At G5, most auxiliary modules gain 300% integrity and draw twice as much power. The FSD gains optimal mass and generates less heat. The power distributor draws less power.
На G5 урон растёт на 75%, предельная дал: At G5, damage rises by 75%, maximum range falls by half, and thermal load rises by 40%. Suitable for weapons you can reliably land at close range.
Банка щита G4 выделяет на 24% меньше теп: At G4, the shield cell bank produces 24% less heat and restores 10% more shield. Power draw rises and integrity falls.
FSD может сжечь на 10% больше топлива за: The FSD can burn 10% more fuel per jump. Compare range and fuel use with Mass Manager at the actual loaded mass of the ship.
После попадания турели и оружие на карда: A hit temporarily disrupts aiming for the target’s turreted and gimballed weapons.
При пробитии корпуса взрыв может задеть: On hull penetration, the blast can damage multiple internal modules. The cannon fires more slowly and each shot deals 35% less damage.
Переводит большую часть урона боеприпасо: Converts most ammunition damage to thermal. Useful against low thermal resistance, though tripled thermal load limits sustained fire.
Повышает оптимальную массу FSD на 4%, ув: Increases FSD optimal mass by 4%, extending range with the same fuel cap per jump. FSD integrity drops by 8%.
Взрыв передаёт дополнительное тепло целя: The blast adds heat and temporarily interferes with sensors in its area of effect.
Взрыв вызывает перезапуск FSD кораблей в: The blast forces ships in its area of effect to reboot their FSD.
Попадания по щиту или корпусу нагревают: Hits on shields or hull heat the target. Direct weapon damage falls by 10%.
